timeline.summary: 30 Apr 2026: Shareholders passed both postal ballot special resolutions — authorised capital raised to ₹61 Cr and a fundraise of up to ₹600 Cr approved with 97.84% of votes in favour.
27 May 2026: Board approved audited FY26 standalone and consolidated results with an unmodified audit opinion and declared a 40% (₹4/share) interim dividend, record date 12 June 2026.
On 28 May 2026, MM Forgings released its FY26 investor presentation reporting consolidated revenue of ₹1,605.62 Cr and an interim dividend of ₹4 per share.
MM Forgings held Q1FY27 earnings call on 17 August 2026, reporting 16% YoY revenue growth to ₹427 Cr and guiding FY27 revenue at ₹1,800-1,900 Cr.
